name: Wyoming

response.rule_text: Readily available records are released immediately; otherwise release not later than thirty calendar days from receipt unless good cause and a mutually agreed date (Wyo. Stat. § 16-4-202(c)); records in storage/active use need notice to the requester within seven business days.

fees.labor_rule: Search and retrieval fees may be charged for electronic records and for creating a new record (Cheyenne Newspapers 2016); reasonable supervision fee when requester copies.
fees.copy_rule: Reasonable fee under a schedule set by rule, regulation, ordinance or law (§ 16-4-204(b)); no charge for inspecting printed records.
fees.waiver_rule: No statutory waiver; custodians may waive under written policy; ombudsman may waive fees (§ 16-4-203(f)(ii)).
fees.late_penalty: Knowing and intentional violation: civil penalty up to $750 (§ 16-4-205).

residency.rule_text: Any person has the right to request inspection of public records; identity and purpose irrelevant.

appeal.body: Public Records Ombudsman (2019), then district court
appeal.rule_text: Requester may ask for written reasons for denial (§ 16-4-203(e)), seek ombudsman mediation, or petition the district court where the records are located for a show-cause order (§ 16-4-203(f)); no specific deadline (civil-procedure rules apply). Supreme Court appeal within 30 days of order.

format_rule: Electronic records provided in alternative formats unless impractical or impossible (§ 16-4-202(d)(ii)); customized compilation not required if it impairs agency duties (§ 16-4-202(d)(iii)).
notes: Read chars 0-160k. Deemed denial not stated; AG role not stated for records. Legislature partly exempt (W.S. 28-8-116), so false is partial. Executive records 'should be subject to the Act' (§ 16-4-202(a)); governor not specifically named. University of Wyoming covered (Sheaffer 2006). Ombudsman created 2019.
